T5-3.title: Table 5-T3: Detail Correlation Drops (printed 5-45, PDF 325)
T5-3.notes_for_reviewers: A printed table of eight model drops, sideways on the page; the packet shows it turned upright. Each row of the checklist names a NASA test number and a column. Its picture shows the test number of that row at the left and, at the right, the column's heading above the cell; the row is boxed in blue in both. A: does the picture show that test and that column? B: does the cell read the value given, character for character, with the minus sign and the decimal point where they are printed (.298 has no zero before the point)? A digit with a break or a missing piece counts as printed if it can still be read with confidence; if it cannot, answer cannot tell and say why in C.
